module: Milestones related to career missions. For the set of showInCareer missions, then for each branch (inferred from gameplay_missions_unlocks.getForwardMissionInfo(...).branchTags), creates three milestones: stars collected (mission_totalStarCount / mission_totalStar_branch_<b>), missions passed with at least one default star (mission_passMissions[_<b>]) and missions completed at 100% of stars (mission_completeMissions[_<b>]). Six tiers: 10, 18, 30, 54, 74 and 100% of the total (rounded up). Notifies at the end of a mission (stopped state).
notes: Only mission_totalStarCount (global) has the general filter and the majorLinear reward; the others use minorLinear.
makeUnlockMissionsMilestones (milestone mission_unlockMissions) is defined but its call is commented out in onGeneralMilestonesCollect; likewise onMissionUnlocked is not exported (inactive).
missionIdToMilestonesList and milestoneConfigs are never cleared between two onGeneralMilestonesCollect calls: reactivating the career may duplicate milestones in these tables.
Stars use mission.careerSetup._activeStarCache (defaultStarCount + bonusStarCount) for the total and gameplay_missions_progress.getUnlockedStarCountsForMissionById for progress.

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: gathers career missions, groups them by branch and creates the global then per-branch milestones.

makeAllMissionStarMilestones.desc: Creates the three global milestones (stars, missions passed, missions completed), registers them for each relevant mission and adds them to milestonesList.

makeBranchMissionStarMilestones.desc: Creates the same three milestones for a given branch (or skill), with the branch name in the labels.

makeUnlockMissionsMilestones.desc: Creates a mission unlock milestone (mission_unlockMissions, target (step+1)). Unused: its call is commented out.

onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks.desc: Hook: sets the notification target of each mission milestone.

setNotificationTarget.desc: Stores in milestone._target the target of the next tier to notify (nothing if all are notified).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook called when a mission's state changes; in the "stopped" state, checks the milestones related to that mission, notifies the reached tiers and advances notificationStep.
